title: Society banquet jobs and prohibition near-beer
summary: Anniversary banquets at society halls paid two dollars; dinner of gumbo and stew, near-beer, playing until five.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: We get jobs in there in the week. We play them. Not gonna get a job any day. Pay more than my job for waking or I'll stop and go play that job. Some little job, like you used to call them bonquets. It didn't play but uh two dollars but I don't care why I was waking. I was not going to go play that bonquets for the partner you have. So, oh man them dinners. Oh yeah, lots to eat. Oh yeah, you had plenty of fun. You had nothing strong but you had this uh what you called it nail beer. Nail beer?
Nail, nail. Not no nail. Oh yeah, during prohibition yeah. Yeah. Something like two-thirds of one percent.
Mm-hmm, all like that. Something like we did. I don't know. I'm telling you, we used to have the time.
Would you play out in the open at those bonquets?

No, we used to be in the hall. Oh, the hall. Yeah. All everyone operated was in the hall. Like a dance hall. Yeah, like the cooperators, perseverance, new hall, sometimes the economy. That's what he, that's them old societies. Yeah. That's what they called the anniversary. They called them bonquets.
Every year they'd have them the same day ten of them. That's right. That's right.
Well then you'd, would you play and then eat later or, or, or do you?
So they'll usually stop at 12 o'clock. Yeah. As soon as you get there, before you hit a tune, you could go get your dinner.

Yeah. Go ahead and then get your gumbo and your chicken stew. Chicken gumbo and chicken stew. And pardon to use the feet. That is good. Mm-hmm. Then you go up and you play. You might play, um, or you get another little snack of one and you refresh it. It's really good. You play till five o'clock. I had to get two dollars for it. And I don't care why I was waking. When they had one of them, I was waking. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah, I quit and go to that tunnel.
